title: Treatment of Late Cancellations in the Comfort Club Missed-Visit Fee
content:
Under the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, a missed-visit fee is treated according to how the most recent forfeited visit on record came about. The most recent forfeited visit is the latest-dated visit recorded as a no-show forfeit or a late-cancellation forfeit on the agreement.

## Forfeit treatment rule
- **Late cancellation, agreement in at least its 5th consecutive term:** the amount is halved and rounded down to a whole dollar.
- **Late cancellation, agreement in fewer than its 5th consecutive term:** the amount is multiplied by three quarters and rounded up to a whole dollar.
- **No-show:** this rule does not change the amount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical amounts)

| Amount | Most recent forfeit | Consecutive term count | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 45.00 | late cancellation | 6 | half is 22.50, rounded down | 22.00 |
| 45.00 | late cancellation | 4 | three quarters is 33.75, rounded up | 34.00 |
| 32.00 | late cancellation | 5 | half is 16.00 | 16.00 |
| 32.00 | late cancellation | 2 | three quarters is 24.00 | 24.00 |
| 45.00 | no-show | any | not changed by this rule | 45.00 |

## Points of judgement
- A no-show in April followed by a late cancellation in September: the most recent forfeited visit is the late cancellation.
- A count of exactly 5 is "at least its 5th consecutive term".
